paragraphs.source_en: *Yokikotokiku*. That auspicious motto indeed had watched over the Inugami clan while Sahei had been alive. Did it still protect them with its power now that the old man was dead? No, looking back on all that was to occur, we can say it no longer protected, but in fact now cursed the Inugami clan. Yet, even our astute Kindaichi remained completely unaware of this, at least until those series of nightmarish incidents gradually opened his eyes.
